'''Tunqstoid''' was an incredibly heavy substance used to make [[Blast door/Legends|blast doors]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]]. [[Galactic Alliance Security Detention Center 81]], a [[Galactic Alliance Security blockhouse|security blockhouse]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] had blast doors made from tunqstoid, which were so heavy they required [[Hovertrain/Legends|mag-lev]] guides instead of tracks. When the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] saw the doors she decided to take an alternate route to getting into the block house and freeing the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] frozen in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] trapped within.<ref name="Aby" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tunqstoid first appeared in the [[2009]] novel ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]'' which was written by [[Troy Denning]] as part of the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series.
